dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hi. I know it sounds silly, but I think there might be a bear in my backyard.
{WHAT IS YOUR NAME?} What is your name, sir?
Amos Hayes
Frank Woolen
Anthony Roswell
{ARE YOU SERIOUS?} Sir, are you sure you have an emergency? Joking 911 line is strictly prohibited.
I'm not joking! I hear the bear right now!
{CAN YOU SEE IT?} Do you see the bear?
No. I haven't seen it. It is just making a really loud and scary growling noise.
{WHAT'S YOUR ADDRESS?} Could I have your address please?
It is [[ADDRESS]]
It is 56 Oak Street
It is 81 Washington Street
It is 21 Main Avenue
{ARE YOU SURE?} Sir, you perfectly sure the bear is there, even though you have not actually seen it. Am I right?
Well... I wouldn't say that I'm perfectly sure, but... it's-it's dark and there is a big bush in our yard and it is sha-shaking and there is a crazy growling sound coming out of it and I...
{ANYTHING ELSE?} Anything else?
Well... I'm hearing he-heavy breathing. And the leaves are rustling.
{DESCRIBE THE SOUND} Could you describe the sound to me?

dialogOption.emotions: caller tries to roar, the result is rather funny, than scary
dialogOption.texten: Hmm... it sounds like AARRRRGHGHGHLGLGLGLGGL...
{THANK YOU} ... Thank you sir.
{I'LL SEND THE FIREFIGHTERS} I will send a firefighters unit as one is available. They will take care of it.
Thank you so much! I'm waiting.
{IT'S PROBABLY NOT DANGEROUS} Sir, if it was a bear, you would recognize it easily. It's probably just a common harmless animal like stray cat or raccoon.
But.. But.. What if it's not?!
{WAS THERE ANY FOOD?} Sir, did you have any food left in your backyard? Even in trash bin?
Yes. yesterday, I made barbecue for a few friends. There was too much leftovers, so I put them the trash bin.
{HIDE IN YOUR HOUSE} If you are outside the house, please come into and lock the door, sir.
Yes, that's a great idea. Wait a second.

{IT'S PROBABLY A CAT} Now, just wait and observe the bush. Try not to leave the house without need. I guess that it's just a cat, but if the bear comes out please call us again and I'll send the emergency unit immediately.
I was hoping that you send somebody now. But okay. I'll wait.
{CHECK THE BUSH} Sir, do you have any pot, pan or something else which can be used to make a noise?
Umm.. Yeah.. Why?
{MAKE A NOISE} I'd like you to make some noise in front of the bush.
What? Why?
If there is actually a bear, it should come out and run away.
Is that wise?
{YOU SHOULD CHECK IT} Sir, we need to confirm that there is a threat before we can dispatch emergency unit.
{I'LL SEND THE FIRE DEPARTMENT} If you afraid to do it alone, I will send the firefighters to check it.

dialogOption.emotions: resigned; [moment of silence, noise of hitting a pot with spoon]

dialogOption.texten: Ohh, there is a bear actually! But it didn't go away! Fuck!
{ARE YOU THERE?}Sir? Sir, are you there?

dialogOption.emotions: sound of running men, chasing by bear; some screams, roars

dialogOption.texten: {DON'T BLOCK THE LINE} As I said there's no sign of emergency situation. Please don't block the line, sir.
Eh... I thought you would treat my problem seriously.... Bye
I could swear I heard a roar. Did you hear it?
Are you still there?

reportElement.texten: Caller reported a wild animal in his backyard.
Operator told the man to lock himself inside the house.
Instructions given by operator caused that caller was attacked by the bear.
The operator decided to not send any unit, because the signs of bear's presence was unclear.
The operator decided to send a unit to investigate the case. The bear was founded in the bush and was transported to the nearest veterinary institution.
